chunks: What was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Harun ibn Muslim, from Mas'adah ibn Ziyad, from Ja'far, from his father, from his forefathers, peace be upon them:

That the Prophet, may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family, said to one of his wives: 'Order the believing women to perform istinja' with water and to be thorough in it, for indeed it is a purifier of the surrounding areas and a remover of hemorrhoids.'

key_terms.الْحَوَاشِي: the surrounding/adjacent areas; the bodily regions around the orifice
key_terms.مَطْهَرَةٌ: purifier; an instrument or means of taharah (ritual purity)
key_terms.يَسْتَنْجِينَ: to perform istinja' — ritual cleansing of the private parts with water after relieving oneself

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet (SAWW) command regarding the use of water for istinja' and its health and ritual benefits according to Shia hadith in Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: The Prophet (SAWW) directed one of his wives to instruct the believing women to perform istinja' (ritual cleansing after relieving oneself) with water and to be thorough in the practice. He gave two reasons: it purifies the surrounding bodily areas (ḥawāshī) and removes hemorrhoids. The hadith is transmitted through Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) via the silsilat al-dhahab chain of his forefathers.
